verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Bugbot only as a pull-request reviewer: it runs automatically on PR updates or when triggered by a PR comment, and posts its findings as PR comments. The "Fix in Cursor" links bring existing PR findings into the editor after the code is already pushed, which is not a pre-push review. One community user's guess that in-IDE review comments were Bugbot is unconfirmed speculation. Nothing documents running the same Bugbot review locally inside the IDE before pushing.
